reason: Section 13 requires every row to receive AGP/RGC treatment: assumptions, weakenings, smallest counterexamples, minimal sufficient conditions, parent ownership and claim ceiling. All fifteen rows carry statement, assumptions, parent_ownership, claim_ceiling, proof_class, ocm_residual and agp_rungs. Three carry an EMPTY assumption_removals list, so the weakening and smallest-counterexample half of the treatment is absent for them. This was found by field-auditing all fifteen rows rather than by sampling one.
audit_method: programmatic field coverage over THEOREM_REGISTRY_V1.theorems; every row checked, not a sample

BIO-T7.statement_asserts: Smallest counterexamples exist; commutation requires stated sufficient conditions.
BIO-T7.defect: The statement asserts that smallest counterexamples exist, and the row records none. A row that claims a counterexample it does not carry is weaker than a row that records the gap.
required_before_closure: at least one smallest counterexample to commutation
the sufficient conditions under which the operations do commute
BIO-T7.owner: EB-F0-P for the parent-ownership half, EB-F0-X for the machine-checked counterexample

BIO-T13.statement_asserts: Byte or copy-count growth can diverge from useful retained capability.
BIO-T13.defect: No weakening recorded, so the conditions under which byte growth DOES track useful capability are unstated. Without them the row cannot discriminate: it forbids one inference without saying when the inference is safe.
required_before_closure: conditions under which stored-byte growth does track useful retained capability
the smallest world where the two diverge
BIO-T13.paired_hostile: H-JUNK-CULTURE, whose clean control is still open per HOSTILE_REGISTRY_V1_AMEND_1

BIO-T14.statement_asserts: Cluster labels do not by themselves imply reproductive or ecological individuality.
BIO-T14.defect: No weakening recorded, so the invariants that WOULD license a strong species claim are named as required but never enumerated.
required_before_closure: the invariants required for a strong species claim
the smallest world where clustering and reproductive individuality disagree
BIO-T14.paired_hostile: H-CLUSTER-AS-GROUP, whose clean control is still open

closure_correction.condition: section 17 condition 6 — theorem registry parent ownership plus assumptions plus falsifiers
closure_correction.why_the_correction_matters: A freeze that reports a condition satisfied when three rows lack the falsifying half is a freeze whose own self-assessment cannot be trusted. Recording the gap is cheaper than discovering it after #292 has consumed the registry as a gate.

no_row_is_removed: All fifteen rows stand. This amendment records what three of them do not yet carry; it does not weaken or restate any statement.
